title: Q2 Remaining Item Disposition and Residue Retirement
purpose: Process the nine remaining Q2 items by prospectively closing the single neutralized lineage item, retiring two obsolete residue items, and reclassifying six items outside Q2.
summary: This patch exhausts the local Q2 queue without changing live lineage authority. AMB-GOV-SURF-0666 is prospectively closed because it is superseded by later migrations. AMB-GOV-SURF-0952 and 0953 are retired as obsolete residue. AMB-GOV-SURF-0875 is reclassified to Q3, and the other five items are reclassified to Q4.
